image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a white and green steam iron standing upright on its heel rest. The iron features a translucent green water tank window with measurement markings. In the background, there is a red cylindrical container (possibly a fire extinguisher or canister) and a yellow bottle with Asian characters on the label. A power cord is visible at the bottom left.

The measurement markings inside the translucent green plastic appear slightly soft and lack the crisp edge definition expected of molded plastic indicators.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the iron / Cord entry
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point where the power cord enters the handle is somewhat indistinct and 'mushy', lacking a clear strain relief or plug housing structure.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model/type classification and ensure it aligns with the 'iron' class label despite the unusual angle.
To verify the spatial relationship between the iron and the background items, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To check for boundary sharpness and ensure the handle and body are a single continuous manifold without melting artifacts.
To rigorously analyze the gibberish text on the background bottles, which is a common AI artifact.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the handle-to-body connection
Clarity and logic of text on background containers
